scripts.predev: npm run gen:admin && npm run build:ui
scripts.prebuild: npm run gen:admin && npm run build:sdk && npm run build:ui
scripts.build:sdk: npm run --prefix sdk/shared_modules build && npm run --prefix sdk build
scripts.pretest: npm run gen:admin && npm run build:sdk && npm run build:ui
scripts.pretest:coverage: npm run gen:admin && npm run build:sdk && npm run build:ui
scripts.test: vitest run tests/ components/ sdk/tracking-analytics/ sdk/remote_config/ sdk/shared_modules/ sdk/formatter/
scripts.test:coverage: vitest run tests/ components/ sdk/tracking-analytics/ sdk/remote_config/ sdk/shared_modules/ sdk/formatter/ --coverage
scripts.check:fast: npm run type-check && npm run lint && gitleaks git --pre-commit --redact --no-banner
scripts.check:architecture: depcruise --validate app lib components hooks sdk/remote_config
scripts.check:security: uvx semgrep scan --config p/default --error app/ lib/ components/ hooks/
scripts.check:task: npm run check:fast && npm run check:architecture && npm run test:coverage
scripts.check:full: npm run check:task && npm run check:security && npm run check:deps
scripts.check:db: supabase db reset && supabase test db && supabase db lint --level warning
scripts.docker:build: docker compose build && docker image prune -f
scripts.docker:up: docker compose up -d --build && docker image prune -f
